# Tier `blackwell-3x16`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `triple-blackwell` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 131072 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-26b-a4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 131072 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `gpu` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3-vl-8b` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | resident |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #17 (3x homogeneous Blackwell 16GB = 48.9 GB; the reference box IS the workstation: RTX 5060 Ti @17:00.0 + RTX 5070 Ti @65:00.0 + RTX 5060 Ti @B5:00.0, X299 / i9-10980XE, quad-channel DDR4-3400 128GB). SHIPPED 0.113.32 (2026-09-07) after the operator asked three times. Before this tier existed the fleet's MOST-measured machine had no tier id at all and Get-Profile filed it as `dual-gpu` -- a tier no hardware has ever run and that the installer refuses to install (CUDA 13 cannot compile sm_70) -- so a fresh install on the box that produces most of the fleet's numbers would have seeded a pure projection. THE THIRD CARD BUYS CONTEXT AND CONCURRENCY, NOT A BIGGER POOLED MODEL (operator directive). Measured: llama.cpp's 3-way aggregate ceiling is 134.4 tok/s at c32 against the pair's 110-120 (+10-20%), and pipeline-parallel vLLM is about 8% SLOWER single-stream than tensor-parallel on two cards because the stages serialize. What it actually buys is KV pool -- 137,898 tokens across three cards versus 78,506 across two -- and headroom. PLACEMENT LAW, measured and load-bearing: anything that fits two cards runs on the 5060 Ti PAIR (devices 0 and 2); the RTX 5070 Ti is the DISPLAY card and stays interactive-first, joining only for over-2-card work, under a >=4 GiB desktop floor, and never while the operator is at the desk -- on 2026-09-04 a 3-card engine at util 0.87-0.90 left it under 1 GB, Windows fell to a 720p-class mode and the operator had to reboot (clean event log, no TDR: starvation, not a crash). The template pins NOTHING to device 1 and a render test asserts it. PIN BY GPU UUID, NEVER INDEX: two of the three cards report the identical board name 'RTX 5060 Ti', and CUDA/ComfyUI ordering does not match nvidia-smi PCI order. AGENT SEAT stays the 2-card-pinned 27B, on measurement: the 3-card vLLM seat FAILED the delegation gate -- a real harness digest contract DEFERRED at 300,010 ms where the two-card seat finished the same contract in 272 s -- so three-card serving is opt-in long-context work, not the delegation lane. THE 3-CARD SEATS THAT DID EARN THEIR PLACE are rendered as opt-in entries: qwen3.8-flash-next at ncmoe28 / --tensor-split 28,10,10 / q8_0 KV / 131k (12.5-12.9 tok/s, +47% over the best 2-card arm, and 15/16 on the seed-48 decision set = exact parity with the 27B incumbent), plus its native-262k twin at ncmoe32 / 32,8,8 (pp 69, tg 11.3 tok/s, needle exact at 11.4k depth; a full 200k prompt is ~48 min of prefill, so batch only). CUDA graphs are ON for the 26B seats (measured 2026-09-05: gen 41.4 -> 58.0 and 39.0 -> 58.8 tok/s, output identical); GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_OPT stays off (changes output, crashes the MTP 12b). MEDIA: ComfyUI does not shard a DiT, so extra cards buy parallel renders and weight-donor storage, never a bigger single render -- the bf16 LTX transformer still OOMs on the COMPUTE device's activations at 1920x1088, which a donor card cannot fix, and int8 DiTs cannot compute on a non-default CUDA device at all (ComfyUI-MultiGPU #220), so videogen is pinned to cuda:0/cuda:1 as a documented law exception. Evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-31-48gb-gates-NOTES.md, 2026-09-01-vllm-lmcache-results/, 2026-09-03-seat-optimization-program.md, 2026-09-05-cudax/. NOT to be confused with blackwell-48, which is ONE RTX PRO 5000 48GB card.
